analysis.analysis: R-001: Normal: Add bookmark into a specific subfolder. Edge: Add bookmark into the root folder. Boundary: Add bookmark at the maximum nesting depth. Abnormal: Add bookmark with an invalid URL structure. R-002: Normal: Delete a single bookmark from the library. Edge: Delete the last remaining bookmark. Boundary: Delete a bookmark while it is currently open in a tab. Abnormal: Delete a bookmark when the bookmarks file is write-protected. R-003: Normal: Add and delete a bookmark using the personal toolbar. Edge: Add the maximum number of bookmarks fitting on the personal toolbar. Boundary: Add a bookmark with an extremely long title to the toolbar. Abnormal: Add a bookmark to a missing or corrupted toolbar container. R-004: Normal: Insert a new bookmark folder into the hierarchy. Edge: Insert a folder at the absolute root level. Boundary: Insert a folder with maximum allowed character length in its name. Abnormal: Insert a folder with a duplicate name where unsupported. R-005: Normal: Double-click a bookmark to launch in a browser window. Edge: Double-click a bookmark with a local file path URL. Boundary: Rapid double-clicking on multiple bookmarks simultaneously. Abnormal: Double-click a bookmark with a malformed or unsupported URI scheme. R-006: Normal: Verify all default packaged bookmarks contain valid HTTP links. Edge: Verify default bookmarks containing secure HTTPS links. Boundary: Verify default bookmarks containing internationalized domain names (IDN). Abnormal: Verify default bookmarks that return 404 or connection errors. R-007: Normal: Edit bookmark name and URL and save successfully. Edge: Edit a bookmark leaving optional fields blank. Boundary: Edit a bookmark with maximum field length limits. Abnormal: Edit a bookmark while simulating disk write failure. R-008: Normal: Delete an empty bookmarks folder. Edge: Delete a folder containing nested subfolders and bookmarks. Boundary: Delete the default root bookmarks folder. Abnormal: Delete a locked or in-use bookmarks folder. R-009: Normal: Add and delete a bookmark separator. Edge: Add multiple consecutive separators. Boundary: Add a separator at the very beginning or end of a list. Abnormal: Delete a non-existent or corrupted separator ID. R-010: Normal: Save bookmark changes and persist across normal browser restart. Edge: Save bookmark changes and persist after an abrupt browser crash. Boundary: Modify bookmarks immediately before initiating a shutdown. Abnormal: Verify bookmarks persistence when storage profile is read-only. R-011: Normal: Execute negative view properties test for bookmarks, folders, and separators. Edge: Execute view properties on a mixed multi-selection. Boundary: Execute view properties on empty selection areas. Abnormal: Execute view properties while object is being deleted. R-012: Normal: Rename a bookmark inline directly in the view. Edge: Rename a bookmark inline with special characters. Boundary: Rename a bookmark inline using an empty string or maximum length. Abnormal: Cancel inline rename using escape key or clicking away with invalid input. R-013: Normal: Find a bookmark using a user-defined custom keyword. Edge: Find a bookmark using a keyword with trailing spaces. Boundary: Find a bookmark using a single-character keyword. Abnormal: Search for a non-existent custom keyword. R-014: Normal: Sort and reverse-sort bookmarks per column ascending and descending. Edge: Sort a column containing empty or null values. Boundary: Sort a list with thousands of bookmark entries. Abnormal: Sort by a non-sortable or custom view column. R-015: Normal: Resize bookmark columns to show and hide entry details. Edge: Resize a column to its minimum visible width. Boundary: Resize a column to exceed the available window width. Abnormal: Resize a non-resizable column type. R-016: Normal: Show and hide specific bookmark columns via context menu. Edge: Toggle visibility of the primary name column. Boundary: Hide all available columns simultaneously. Abnormal: Show a non-existent column identifier. R-017: Normal: Delete several selected bookmarks at one time. Edge: Delete all bookmarks in a folder simultaneously. Boundary: Delete a selection containing a mix of folders, bookmarks, and separators. Abnormal: Delete a batch of bookmarks where one item is locked. R-018: Normal: Attempt to drop a bookmark onto itself and verify rejection. Edge: Attempt to drop a bookmark onto its immediate parent. Boundary: Attempt to drop a bookmark onto its immediate child. Abnormal: Attempt to drop a bookmark onto an arbitrary unrelated valid target.
